sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the headwear of herders and villagers living under the fallen hulls of a broken ring, in ivory, sage and faded vermilion. Three pieces, each worn by a head-and-shoulders figure, front and three-quarter view: a herder's ivory hood; a round felt cap; a hull-worker's head-cloth tied at the back. Every piece sits close on the head, one clear silhouette each, readable from far away. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, ivory, sage and faded vermilion, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, costume party.
